name: Phillip Andre Botello
bio: Phillip Andre Botello is an actor, known for The Art of Self-Defense (2019), Pledge (2018) and Funny People (2009).

credits.title: Dry
credits.overview: Jamie struggles at work, contributing to her alcoholism. Meanwhile, her neighbor, David, has a growing obsession with pornography. Soon, each of their habits become all consuming as they sink into the horrors of addiction.

credits.title: Shot Clock
credits.overview: A college basketball star is called to stand for social justice by an activist who is forced to work with police to alleviate racial tensions in their city.

credits.title: Stalked
credits.overview: A group of YouTubers investigate a legendary ghost town where the entire population vanished overnight. In pursuit of internet fame, they stumble upon a seemingly unoccupied farm that may hold the answers to the town's eerie disappearance.

credits.title: The Mold
credits.overview: After an isolated photographer confines a faceless being to her darkroom, her mental and physical identity begin to deteriorate.

credits.title: Greed & Gore
credits.overview: After a Heist goes wrong, the thieves find refuge at an abandoned house. Unbeknownst to them, something evil and violent awaits.  Upcoming Canadian feature adaptation of the Award Winning horror short of the same name.

credits.title: You Can See Everything
credits.overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

credits.title: The Cycle
credits.overview: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

credits.title: Forge
credits.overview: In Miami, siblings Raymond and Coco Zhang’s art forgery ring flourishes when they encounter a disgraced millionaire in need of their expertise. Meanwhile, FBI Art Crimes agent Emily Lee moves to Miami to investigate a series of mysterious paintings.

credits.title: Miss Matched
credits.overview: After a messy divorce, an architect who believes his rare skin condition makes him undateable hires a quirky matchmaker—sparking a partnership that forces them both to rewrite their rules on love.

credits.title: Who Could Kill a Sweet Old Lady
credits.overview: When Edie becomes the new caregiver to an extremely rich elderly woman, she soon starts to suspect that someone wants her client dead - and that she's now the only thing standing in their way.

credits.title: Party USA
credits.overview: When Taylor can't get her party store shift covered after her dad dies, she makes a deadly mistake that sparks a downward spiral of red, white and blue-collared chaos.

credits.title: The Woman Before Me
credits.overview: When Jenna learns her husband was once married to a woman who could be her double, she unravels a chilling pattern of obsession, deceit, and murder that makes her question whether she’s his next victim.

credits.title: Yesterday is Almost Here
credits.overview: It's the kind of alliance that writes itself. Two wronged partners, one cheating couple to take down. Which is exactly why it should worry you.

credits.title: Premarital
credits.overview: Pastor Stewart Whitaker learns his daughter's fiancé isn't a believer just days before their wedding. His clumsy plan to convert him unravels into a funny, heartfelt clash of faith, family image, hypocrisy, and truth in small-town America.

credits.title: Spine Scam
credits.overview: A young neurosurgeon uncovers corruption in spine surgery as a patient's recovery through a laser procedure sparks an investigation exposing bribery, unnecessary fusions, and a medical scandal hurting patients.

credits.title: Deadly Vows
credits.overview: After fleeing the Iran-Iraq war, Darya begins a new life in Los Angeles and is swept off her feet by the charming Sam Lebon. credits.title: The Codes of War
credits.overview: War stories about family, ethics and honor include the true story of two U.S. Marines who in a span of six seconds, must stand their ground to stop a suicide truck bomb, a Navy Corpsman who attempts to hold on to his humanity, and a WW2 soldier who gets separated from his squad and is forced to re-evaluate his code.

credits.title: Becoming Vera
credits.overview: In Miami, 18-year-old pianist Vera, a foster child aging out of the system, struggles to pursue her passion for Latin Jazz amidst poverty and exploitation. After landing a freelance job painting a music studio, she impresses Hector, the studio owner and music producer, who offers her a chance to compose. However, Hecto

credits.title: V/H/S/Beyond
credits.overview: The infinite playground of forbidden worlds and dangerous lifeforms offered by the sci-fi horror genre will lead to the biggest, maddest, bloodiest V/H/S ever.

credits.title: Who's Cheating Who?
credits.overview: Follows two married couples, Stephanie/Mason and Maxine/Steven, whose lives intertwine through affairs. Stephanie starts an affair with Steven after discovering Mason's infidelity with Maxine.

credits.title: A Killer in the House
credits.overview: When a psycho killer becomes obsessed with a beautiful girl, he does everything he can to win her over, including killing everybody in his way. This is a study of a psycho killer, his prey, and how far he is willing to go.

credits.title: Adjunct
credits.overview: A promising writer-turned-adjunct college professor grapples with the harsh reality of being undervalued and disposable in academia. As he confronts mounting disillusionment, he must chart a new path forward.

credits.title: The A-Frame
credits.overview: A quantum physicist develops a machine that creates a tunnel to a subatomic universe. In his quest to prove the machine's efficacy, he inadvertently discovers a radical treatment for cancer in lab rats. He now seeks human volunteers.

credits.title: The Legend of Catclaws Mountain
credits.overview: Mindy adopts Angel, a high-spirited pony that—according to legend—will lead its owner to gold hidden in the nearby mountains. credits.title: Finding Love in Saint Lucia
credits.overview: An Ornithologist and a Journalist partner up to save an endangered bird species in the jungle of Santa Lucia. They immediately fall in love with the nature, and in the process, they’ll also fall in love with each other.

credits.title: Model House
credits.overview: Five swimsuit models staying together in a secluded house fight to stay alive when intruders break in and hold them captive to extort money from their social media followers.

credits.title: Loss of Essence
credits.overview: When Stewart Berwick flocks to the woods to direct his first feature film, his eccentric crew suffers through an intense shoot.

credits.title: Planetquake
credits.overview: A tectonic shift deep below the Mariana Trench causes a series of ever escalating earthquakes. If a team of leading seismologists fails to stop the disaster, the events will break apart the Earth, resulting in billions of casualties. Finally, someone’s paying attention to our leading seismologists.

credits.title: The Night They Came Home
credits.overview: The combined force of local lawmen and Indian police aim to take down the the Rufus Buck Gang, a cold-heated band of fugitives with vengeance on their minds.

credits.title: Sight: Extended
credits.overview: In a near future dominated by augmented-reality eyepieces, a troubled young man who suffers from agoraphobia experiences an unlikely transformation when he comes across a mysterious app that transforms every facet of his life into a game.

credits.title: Fallen Drive
credits.overview: On the night of their ten year high school reunion, Charlie and her boyfriend Reese return to their hometown with plans to exact revenge on a former classmate.

credits.title: Look Who's Stalking
credits.overview: Dr. Hope Connors escaped her stalker and decides to move her family to the suburbs for a fresh start. But when odd signs that her stalker is back start up again she is thrust back into her fear and paranoia.

credits.title: Above the Clouds
credits.overview: A lost dog, a cassette tape, and a backyard comedy show bring two Asian-American strangers together for a day they'll never forget.

credits.title: Hemet is Heaven
credits.overview: An aspiring filmmaker sets out to document the hidden gems of his hometown while confronting his own struggles with self-doubt and authenticity.

credits.title: 2025 Armageddon
credits.overview: A militant alien race launches an attack on Earth using gigantic creatures and geological disasters all based on those found on The Asylum's Movie Channel signal which reached their planet.

credits.title: The Dinner Parting
credits.overview: Susan and Henry are hosting a dinner party, while trying to make good on a lie concerning the recent death of their father. Unexpected guests arrive, causing the night to unravel despite Susan's best efforts.

credits.title: All Jacked Up and Full of Worms
credits.overview: A maintenance man for a seedy motel embarks on a path of self-destruction through the alleyways of Chicago after he discovers a hidden stash of powerful hallucinogenic worms.

credits.title: As Real As You Make It
credits.overview: A homeless man is swept up in the lives of the Moffetts, a manic B-Level Hollywood family.

credits.title: Twenty-Nine
credits.overview: Jeff and Daley fall in love at exactly the wrong time. When work and family threaten to pull them apart, they must go on a journey of self-discovery, learn how to navigate adulthood, and get out of being stuck in a life they didn’t choose.

credits.title: Wanton Want
credits.overview: An affectless writer is lured to a couples weekend getaway by his wife and friends, only to uncover a tumultuous secret and a perilous obsession that threaten to change the course of his life in intense and surprising ways.

credits.title: Tales of a Fifth Grade Robin Hood
credits.overview: After a young boy in an under-funded inner-city school discovers the head of the school board is stealing money from fundraisers and lives in a mansion, he organizes his friends together to get that money back where it belongs: in the classroom.

credits.title: Weekend Warriors
credits.overview: A fun camping trip turns into a desperate fight for survival after two kids witness a horrific event in the wild. They have to endure the elements and wildlife and they must also find a way to reach civilization before it's too late.

credits.title: Transfer
credits.overview: Transfer is a film set in a surrealist reality that revolves around two strangers having the world’s weirdest job interview. Each character must come to terms with death, the idea of choice, and the inevitable truth that not everyone gets a second chance at life.

credits.title: Sunset on the River Styx
credits.overview: A chance meeting of two morose lovers sends them spiraling down a surreal rabbit hole. Their relationship will be challenged by their pasts, their futures, their perception of time, and a vampire death cult.

credits.title: Restricted Area
credits.overview: Four blue-collar friends, recently laid off from the steel mill, take one last camping trip into the wilderness when they discover a backwoods cult with a cataclysmic agenda and must fight to survive.

credits.title: Mermaid Down
credits.overview: A mermaid is ripped from the ocean by a fishing crew only to be tortured and to have her tail cut off. A seemingly helpful stranger intervenes, but then locks her away in an institution for mentally disturbed young women, where no one believes she is a mermaid. credits.title: Devil's Revenge
credits.overview: John Brock is a down-on-his-luck archaeologist who returns from an expedition to the caves of rural Kentucky after unsuccessfully trying to locate a mysterious relic that his family has sought for generations. Upon his return, John starts to see dream-like visions of a ferocious bird-like creature from ancient folklore

credits.title: The Art of Self-Defense
credits.overview: Casey is attacked at random on the street and enlists in a local dojo led by a charismatic and mysterious Sensei in an effort to learn how to defend himself. What he uncovers is a sinister world of fraternity, violence and hypermasculinity and a woman fighting for her place in it.

credits.title: Underdog
credits.overview: A young girl meets a MMA coach and they quickly form a bond based on their mutual struggles with their own addictions.

credits.title: Spiral
credits.overview: Alone in his new apartment for the first time, a young man is tricked into smoking laced weed and must survive an all-night adventure with his maniacal next-door neighbor.

credits.title: Bentley's Will
credits.overview: A mother and son are forced to confront a strained relationship and begin the slow journey of healing while searching for their missing dog.

credits.title: Out of Sight, Out of Mind
credits.overview: Travis's tight social group of friends and lovers splits apart when his childhood friend, O'Brien becomes severely mentally ill. credits.title: Pledge
credits.overview: Three friends pledge a fraternity that's deadly serious about its secret rituals, turning their rush into a race for survival.

credits.title: Minutes to Midnight
credits.overview: On the cusp of New Year's Eve, seven friends and a mysterious backpacker converge at a desolate ski lodge in the mountains when they are systematically hunted down by ruthless masked men with a cryptic agenda.

credits.title: Benjamin Troubles
credits.overview: Benjamin Troubles is a tale of urban magic that follows Ben, an out of luck loser, who finds himself suddenly endowed with large sums of money due to a mysterious gift, a pair of magic jeans that produce $100 bills every hour.

credits.title: The Bang Bang Brokers
credits.overview: A suicidal stockbroker convinces a Black gang and a Latin gang to join forces and use street moves to sway a hedge fund. A vicious fast moving Action Comedy from the writer / director of The Weathered Underground.

credits.title: Silver Skies
credits.overview: A group of eccentric retirees' lives are turned upside down when their beloved apartment complex is suddenly sold out from under them.

credits.title: Reclaiming Friendship Park
credits.overview: Why would a tough businessman suddenly become obsessed with friendship if not to reclaim something that he never knew he gave away?

credits.title: Bikini Model Academy
credits.overview: When T. J. and Benji, two California twenty-something best buddies, lose their girlfriends, they start a home grown bikini modeling academy to make money and meet new girls. credits.overview: Billy is the self-designated leader of a group of teenagers living in a shelter. Jacob and Rae, Billy's oldest childhood friends, live there as well as part of "the family". credits.title: The Before Time
credits.overview: When two rival crews head into the desert to shoot a reality show based on a buried Navajo treasure, they discover that truth is not only stranger than fiction, it's more dangerous. Something wants them from digging deeper and from escaping the desert alive.

credits.title: Bachelor Night
credits.overview: When a bachelor party and a bachelorette party cross paths in Vegas, only the best man and maid of honor can save their friends from a night of epic "mistakes."

credits.title: Mega Shark vs. Mecha Shark
credits.overview: When another Mega Shark returns from the depths of the sea, world militaries go on high alert. Ocean traffic grinds to a standstill as everyone lives in fear of the insatiable beast. credits.title: Attila
credits.overview: When American soldiers inadvertently steal Attila the Hun's secret riches, the wrath of the barbarian is awakened; the mummified warrior will stop at nothing to kill the intruders.

credits.title: Fabulous High
credits.overview: A new, independently produced, LGBT series that focuses on the lives of several high school characters, facing the realities of teenagers today. credits.title: Celebrity Sex Tape
credits.overview: A group of college nerds secretly record a washed up celebrity having sex and post the tape on the internet. When the publicity revives the actress's career, every B-list celebrity, reality show reject, and celebutante in Hollywood want to star in the guys next "production."

credits.title: Funny People
credits.overview: Famous and wealthy funnyman George Simmons doesn't give much thought to how he treats people until a doctor delivers stunning health news, forcing George to reevaluate his priorities with a little help from aspiring stand-up comic Ira.

credits.title: Hoodrats 2: Hoodrat Warriors
credits.overview: Beautiful girls kicking ass, smashing skulls and fighting gang members in Los Angeles. One battle after another, culminating in a confrontation with the king of the streets.
